name: NATO Locked Shields
description: World's largest live-fire cyber defense exercise, organized annually by NATO CCDCOE. Over 4,000 experts from 40+ nations defend more than 6,000 virtualized systems against 8,000+ real attack actions spanning power grids, financial networks, 5G infrastructure, and military command systems. Blue teams must detect, respond, and report under extreme time pressure and information uncertainty.
reputation: Premier international live-fire cyber defense exercise; benchmark for national and institutional cyber readiness
notes: Annual exercise held in Tallinn, Estonia. Participation by invitation only for NATO member and partner nations. Covers legal, strategic, and technical dimensions simultaneously.

institutions: NATO CCDCOE (Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence)
